scope: One-sided simultaneous Gaussian mean tests, common unknown stationary AR coefficient in [0,1), unrestricted contemporaneous covariance. The heterogeneous-persistence cell is a diagnostic outside the guarantee.

procedure.basis: Fixed rounded-integer cosine contrasts; exact rational orthogonal projection
procedure.low_rank: Nearest even integer to n^(1/3), ties upwards; bounded by 2 and n-3
procedure.innovation_count: Largest odd integer at most T-1

power.target: Only candidate 0 has mean delta times its true standard deviation of the sample mean; all other candidates remain at zero. Common noise is used for the four shifts within each independent replicate.

partial_null.target: Even-index candidates, including the prespecified reference 0, have positive means; odd-index candidates have zero means. Strong FWER counts only rejection of an odd-index candidate.

uncertainty_reporting: Pointwise 95% Wilson intervals for rates; paired normal intervals and exact McNemar p-values for power differences. Descriptive intervals are not simultaneous. CI coverage is checked separately from null rejection. No parameter tuning or size-matching on formal data.
cost_decomposition: Known-phi alpha versus known-phi certified alpha-beta cutoff isolates confidence-budget and at-most-one-df rounding cost. Known-phi certified cutoff versus uncertainty procedure isolates the envelope and certificate cost. Both use the same observations and GLS mean target.
boundary: If the outer confidence set retains phi=1, the procedure returns no rejection. This yields a procedure-specific power ceiling, not a bound for all valid tests.
rng: NumPy SeedSequence([phase_seed, 43, phase, group_id, replicate, 0]); stationary Gaussian initial values; no observations or invalid replicates are dropped.
snapshot_replicates: 0, floor(R/2), R-1 in each cell, all shifts; independent audit regenerates these entire datasets and certificates. Other records receive arithmetic and hash checks.
